items.source: Note that the target object (businessObjectTarget in the preceding example) must be a prototype. This lets the PoolingTargetSource implementation create new instances of the target to grow the pool as necessary. See the javadoc of AbstractPoolingTargetSource and the concrete subclass you wish to use for information about its properties. maxSize is the most basic and is always guaranteed to be present.
items.translation: 请注意，目标对象（前例中的businessObjectTarget）必须是原型。这使得PoolingTargetSource 实现能够创建新的目标实例以根据需要扩展连接池。有关其属性的信息，请参阅AbstractPoolingTargetSource的 javadoc 以及您希望使用的具体子类。maxSize是最基本的属性，始终保证存在。

items.source: This advisor is obtained by calling a convenience method on the AbstractPoolingTargetSource class, hence the use of MethodInvokingFactoryBean. This advisor’s name (poolConfigAdvisor, here) must be in the list of interceptors names in the ProxyFactoryBean that exposes the pooled object.
items.translation: 该顾问是通过调用AbstractPoolingTargetSource类的便捷方法获得的，因此使用了MethodInvokingFactoryBean。此顾问的名称（此处为poolConfigAdvisor）必须包含在暴露池化对象的ProxyFactoryBean的拦截器名称列表中。

items.source: Spring offers the concept of a TargetSource, expressed in the org.springframework.aop.TargetSource interface. This interface is responsible for returning the “target object” that implements the join point. The TargetSource implementation is asked for a target instance each time the AOP proxy handles a method invocation.
items.translation: Spring 提供了 TargetSource 的概念，该概念在 org.springframework.aop.TargetSource 接口中体现。此接口负责返回实现连接点的“目标对象”。每次 AOP 代理处理方法调用时，都会请求 TargetSource 实现提供一个目标实例。

items.source: ThreadLocal target sources are useful if you need an object to be created for each incoming request (per thread that is). The concept of a ThreadLocal provides a JDK-wide facility to transparently store a resource alongside a thread. Setting up a ThreadLocalTargetSource is pretty much the same as was explained for the other types of target source, as the following example shows:
items.translation: ThreadLocal 目标源在需要为每个传入请求（即每个线程）创建对象时非常有用。ThreadLocal 的概念提供了一个 JDK 范围的设施，用于透明地将资源与线程一起存储。设置 ThreadLocalTargetSource 与其他类型的目标源基本相同，如下例所示：

items.source: Developers who use Spring AOP do not normally need to work directly with TargetSource implementations, but this provides a powerful means of supporting pooling, hot swappable, and other sophisticated targets. For example, a pooling TargetSource can return a different target instance for each invocation, by using a pool to manage instances.
items.translation: 使用 Spring AOP 的开发者通常不需要直接与TargetSource实现一起工作，但这为支持连接池、热插拔以及其他高级目标提供了强大的手段。例如，一个基于连接池的TargetSource可以通过使用连接池来管理实例，从而为每次调用返回不同的目标实例。

items.source: Although this example does not add any advice (it is not necessary to add advice to use a TargetSource), any TargetSource can be used in conjunction with arbitrary advice.
items.translation: 尽管本示例未添加任何建议（使用TargetSource并不需要添加建议），但任何TargetSource都可以与任意建议配合使用。

items.source: Spring provides support for Commons Pool 2, which provides a fairly efficient pooling implementation. You need the commons-pool Jar on your application’s classpath to use this feature. You can also subclass org.springframework.aop.target.AbstractPoolingTargetSource to support any other pooling API.
items.translation: Spring 提供对 Commons Pool 2 的支持，它提供了相当高效的池化实现。要在应用程序类路径中使用此功能，需要包含 commons-pool Jar。您也可以通过继承org.springframework.aop.target.AbstractPoolingTargetSource来支持任何其他池化 API。

items.source: In this case, myInterceptor is the name of an interceptor that would need to be defined in the same IoC context. However, you need not specify interceptors to use pooling. If you want only pooling and no other advice, do not set the interceptorNames property at all.
items.translation: 在这种情况下，`myInterceptor` 是需要定义在同一 IoC 上下文中的拦截器的名称。但是，使用连接池并不需要指定拦截器。如果您只需要连接池功能而不需要其他建议，则完全不要设置 `interceptorNames` 属性。

items.source: If you do not specify a TargetSource, a default implementation is used to wrap a local object. The same target is returned for each invocation (as you would expect).
items.translation: 如果您未指定 TargetSource，则使用默认实现来包装本地对象。每次调用都会返回同一个目标（正如您预期的那样）。

items.source: The org.springframework.aop.target.HotSwappableTargetSource exists to let the target of an AOP proxy be switched while letting callers keep their references to it.
items.translation: org.springframework.aop.target.HotSwappableTargetSource 的存在是为了允许在让调用方保持对其引用的同时，切换 AOP 代理的目标。

items.source: Changing the target source’s target takes effect immediately. The HotSwappableTargetSource is thread-safe.
items.translation: 更改目标源的目标会立即生效。HotSwappableTargetSource 是线程安全的。

items.source: You can change the target by using the swap() method on HotSwappableTargetSource, as the follow example shows:
items.translation: 您可以使用 HotSwappableTargetSource 上的swap()方法来更改目标，如下例所示：

items.source: The preceding swap() call changes the target of the swappable bean. Clients that hold a reference to that bean are unaware of the change but immediately start hitting the new target.
items.translation: 前面的swap()调用更改了可交换 Bean 的目标。持有该 Bean 引用的客户端未意识到此更改，但会立即访问新目标。

items.source: You can configure Spring to be able to cast any pooled object to the org.springframework.aop.target.PoolingConfig interface, which exposes information about the configuration and current size of the pool through an introduction. You need to define an advisor similar to the following:
items.translation: 您可以配置 Spring，使其能够将任何池化对象转换为 org.springframework.aop.target.PoolingConfig 接口，该接口通过引入机制暴露有关池配置和当前大小的信息。您需要定义一个类似于以下的顾问：

items.source: Simpler pooling is available by using auto-proxying. You can set the TargetSource implementations used by any auto-proxy creator.
items.translation: 通过使用自动代理，可以获得更简单的连接池。您可以设置任何自动代理创建器所使用的TargetSource实现。

items.source: Setting up a “prototype” target source is similar to setting up a pooling TargetSource. In this case, a new instance of the target is created on every method invocation. Although the cost of creating a new object is not high in a modern JVM, the cost of wiring up the new object (satisfying its IoC dependencies) may be more expensive. Thus, you should not use this approach without very good reason.
items.translation: 配置“原型”目标源类似于配置池化 TargetSource。在这种情况下，每次方法调用都会创建一个新的目标实例。尽管在现代 JVM 中创建新对象的成本不高，但为新对象进行装配（满足其 IoC 依赖）的成本可能更高。因此，除非有非常充分的理由，否则不应使用这种方法。

items.source: To do this, you could modify the poolTargetSource definition shown earlier as follows (we also changed the name, for clarity):
items.translation: 为此，您可以按照以下方式修改前面所示的poolTargetSource定义（我们也更改了名称，以便更清晰）：

items.source: The only property is the name of the target bean. Inheritance is used in the TargetSource implementations to ensure consistent naming. As with the pooling target source, the target bean must be a prototype bean definition.
items.translation: 唯一的属性是目标 Bean 的名称。在 TargetSource 实现中使用继承来确保命名的一致性。与池化目标源一样，目标 Bean 必须是原型 Bean 定义。

items.source: The rest of this section describes the standard target sources provided with Spring and how you can use them.
items.translation: 本节其余部分描述了随 Spring 提供的标准目标源以及如何使用它们。

items.source: The following example shows the required XML definitions:
items.translation: 以下示例显示了所需的 XML 定义：

items.source:
Using a pooling target source provides a similar programming model to stateless session
EJBs, in which a pool of identical instances is maintained, with method invocations
going to free objects in the pool.
items.translation: 使用池化目标源提供的编程模型与无状态会话 EJB 类似，其中维护一个相同实例的池，方法调用指向池中可用的对象。

items.source:
A crucial difference between Spring pooling and SLSB pooling is that Spring pooling can
be applied to any POJO. As with Spring in general, this service can be applied in a
non-invasive way.
items.translation: Spring 池化与 SLSB 池化的一个关键区别在于，Spring 池化可以应用于任何 POJO。与 Spring 总体情况一样，该服务可以以非侵入式方式应用。

items.source: ThreadLocal instances come with serious issues (potentially resulting in memory leaks) when incorrectly using them in multi-threaded and multi-classloader environments. You should always consider wrapping a ThreadLocal in some other class and never directly use the ThreadLocal itself (except in the wrapper class). Also, you should always remember to correctly set and unset (where the latter involves a call to ThreadLocal.remove()) the resource local to the thread. Unsetting should be done in any case, since not unsetting it might result in problematic behavior. Spring’s ThreadLocal support does this for you and should always be considered in favor of using ThreadLocal instances without other proper handling code.
items.translation: ThreadLocal 实例在多线程和多类加载器环境中使用不当时会带来严重问题（可能导致内存泄漏）。您应始终考虑将 ThreadLocal 包装在其他类中，而不要直接使用 ThreadLocal 本身（除非是在包装类中）。此外，您应始终记得正确设置和取消设置线程本地的资源（后者涉及调用ThreadLocal.remove()）。无论何种情况都应执行取消设置操作，因为未执行该操作可能会导致问题行为。Spring 的 ThreadLocal 支持会为您完成此操作，并且在使用 ThreadLocal 实例时，应始终优先考虑使用带有其他适当处理代码的版本。

items.source: When using a custom target source, your target will usually need to be a prototype rather than a singleton bean definition. This allows Spring to create a new target instance when required.
items.translation: 使用自定义目标源时，您的目标通常应该是原型（prototype）而非单例（singleton）bean 定义。这样 Spring 可以在需要时创建新的目标实例。

items.source: Pooling stateless service objects is not usually necessary. We do not believe it should be the default choice, as most stateless objects are naturally thread-safe, and instance pooling is problematic if resources are cached.
items.translation: 通常不需要池化无状态服务对象。我们认为不应将其作为默认选择，因为大多数无状态对象天然支持线程安全，而如果缓存资源，实例池化可能会引发问题。
